entries.title: Victoria of Many Faces
entries.jpTitle: 手札が多めのビクトリア
entries.synopsis: In an age when spies act behind the scenes in every land, Chloe spends her days successfully carrying out even the most difficult missions due to her unparalleled disguise skills and martial arts abilities. After the betrayal of her boss, she suddenly disappears—as Chloe plans to redo her life as the ordinary citizen Victoria in the neighboring kingdom of Ashberry, striving for a “normal” life. However, Victoria's peaceful life is abruptly cut short as she begins to get involved with many people. In this new land, her experiences and abilities from her days as a spy come in far more useful than she ever expected! On the other hand, the second prince--and others--take an interest in Victoria's strength, and the shadows close in on the woman with many faces…  (Source: Yen Press)

review.en: It feels like watching a great classic film from another era. Chloe’s new life with Nonna, the people she meets, and the emotions that grow out of those relationships are portrayed with remarkable care. Everyone is so kind and warm, and that is precisely what makes it all so bittersweet. I genuinely want everyone to give this a watch.
review.jp: 往年の名作クラシック映画を見ているかのような作品。ノンナとともに暮らすクロエが関わる人々との交わりやその心情がとても丁寧に描かれる。みな優しく温かい、そしてだからこそ、それがとても切ない。すべての人に是非見てもらいたい。

entries.title: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『ヘルモード　～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～』2nd Season
entries.romanized_title: Hell Mode: Yarikomi-zuki no Gamer wa Haisettei no Isekai de Musou Suru 2nd Season
entries.synopsis: The second season of Hell Mode.

review.en: It is a shame that the second season feels quite rushed, but it is still every bit as entertaining. The animation quality is about what you would expect from an isekai series, but the story feels thoughtfully put together, and you can really sense the passion behind the production, so there is more than enough here to sink your teeth into. I wish they had given it a little more time, but I am still enjoying it immensely—in fact, I think it is excellent and absolutely worth watching.
review.jp: 第二シーズンは大分駆け足なのが残念ではあるが、面白いことに変わりはない。作画クオリティは異世界（転生？）ものとして想像の範疇のものではあるが、丁寧に考えられ制作の熱意もかなり感じられる作りになっているので見ごたえは十十二分にある。もう少し時間をかけて欲しかったがそれでも存分に楽しんでいる、というか素晴らしいので是非見て欲しい。

entries.title: Draw This, Then Die!
entries.synopsis: First-year high school student Ai Yasumi lives on the island of Izu Oshima and loves reading manga. But after a certain turning point, she sets her sights on creating stories of her own! As she dives into the world of manga-making, Ai faces challenges, growth, and the excitement of chasing her creative dreams. Where will her creative journey take her?  (Source: Crunchyroll)

review.en: The teacher’s past and her students’ present are portrayed almost in parallel while gradually intersecting, and that is one of the most interesting aspects of the series. Some parts—such as the process of pursuing manga as a career—do feel somewhat familiar, but each storyline and character is written in a way that enhances the others. As a whole, it feels remarkably complete and absolutely bursting with charm.
review.jp: 先生を中心とした過去の世界とその生徒たちの現在が交わりながらもパラレルに描かれる。そこがこの作品の面白さでもある。漫画家を目指す過程など、多少なりとも既視感のあるような部分もあるが、それぞれのパート、キャラが他の部分を引き立てるように描かれており、全体としての完成度も高く、とんでもなく魅力溢れる作品となっている。

entries.title: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2
entries.romanized_title: Seihantai na Kimi to Boku 2nd Season
entries.synopsis: The second season of Seihantai na Kimi to Boku.

review.en: It is a treasure chest packed with endlessly relatable high school life—everyday interactions, conversations, and inner monologues. Is there some encyclopedia out there containing all of this? There is no way I could not watch this.
review.jp: 共感がとめどなく溢れまくる高校生の日常、やり取り、独り言のすべてが詰まった玉手箱。そんな百科事典でもどこかにあるのか？これを見ないで済むはずはない。見るべし！

entries.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia
entries.jpTitle: 天幕のジャードゥーガル
entries.synopsis: After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.  (Source: Crunchyroll)

review.en: Overwhelming quality, depth, and direction. There is still a long way to go, but I cannot wait to see where it goes from here. There is simply no way I could leave this one out.
review.jp: 圧倒的なクオリティ、深み、演出。まだまだこれからだが、今後の展開が楽しみで仕方ない。これを外せるはずもなし。

entries.title: Dara-san of Reiwa
entries.synopsis: Clouds blacken the sky and sheets of rain turn the mountain forest into a treacherous maze... A landslide crushes a razor wire fence, and buries a "NO TRESPASSING" sign... Two young siblings wander into a dark world where they do not belong, and a long, horrid shadow rears up to meet them- Anyway, so that's how we met Dara-san! She might look kinda scary, but just wait until you get to know her!  "Look, I'm a god of misfortune, okay!? Aren't you kids gonna freak out about my grotesque visage!?"  (Source: Yen Press)

review.en: This may actually be my personal favorite of the season. Its strong horror and occult elements are portrayed with tenderness, reverence, awe, and affection. Even the completely outrageous comedy never undermines that—in fact, it somehow becomes part of the series’ strange and completely unique charm.
review.jp: これ、実は個人的には今期一番好きな作品かも。ホラー・オカルト的な要素が強さとともに慈しみや尊さ、畏怖、そして愛情を持って描かれるが、それはぶっ飛んだコメディ要素があっても変わらないどころか、寧ろそれがこの作品の唯一無二の不思議な魅力ともなっている。

entries.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3
entries.jpTitle: 無職転生Ⅲ ～異世界行ったら本気だす～
entries.romanized_title: Mushoku Tensei III: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
entries.synopsis: Third season of Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu.

review.en: The careful craftsmanship, visual storytelling, and direction become more impressive as the story goes on. That tendency feels especially strong this season, and there is plenty here to sink your teeth into. On the other hand, it is also true that the story can feel relatively uneventful. I cannot wait to see Eris return after being absent since the first two episodes—and finally reunite with Rudeus.
review.jp: 回を増すごとに丁寧な作り込み、描写、演出が増していく。今期は特にその傾向が強く、見応えも十分。ただその反面大きな動きを感じにくいのも確か。エリスの1、２話目振りの登場、そしてついに・・・のルーデウスとの再会が待ち遠しい。

entries.title: Let's Go Kaikigumi
entries.synopsis: The horror comedy manga begins one fateful day when the cowardly (unnamed) protagonist meets Mechako, the leader of the "Kaikigumi" organization which is in charge of the ghosts and supernatural creatures scaring humans. The protagonist somehow takes part in the revival of the Kaikigumi, after which one bizarre (yet not scary) phenomenon after another crops up around him.  (Source: ANN)

review.en: This is actually the dark horse of the season. It is genuinely hilarious and incredibly addictive. At first I thought the protagonist’s exaggerated reactions might be too much, but you get used to them almost immediately—and they actually become surprisingly effective. The entire cast is extremely charming, and the sense of humor is spot-on. I think the quieter, more sentimental episodes will work well too. I really want more people to watch this.
review.jp: これは実は今期のダークホース。マジで面白くて癖になる。主人公の驚きぶりが最初はダメかなぁ・・・と思ったが、すぐに慣れるし、実は結構効いてくる。各キャラも非常に魅力的。ギャグのセンスも絶妙。ちょっとしっとりとした話も合うはず。みんなに見て欲しい。

entries.title: Iron Wok Jan!
entries.synopsis: Jan Akiyama, a cocky arrogant teenager wants to fulfill his grandfathers wish of defeating his arch nemesis Mutsuju Gobancho. When he arrives at the Gobancho restaurant he meets his granddaughter Kiriko Gobancho. Their rivalry is easily compared to Jan's and Kiriko's grandfathers, for Jan believes cooking is about competition and Kiriko believes cooking is about heart.

review.en: You can definitely feel the era it comes from, but it never feels so dated that it becomes difficult to watch. It boldly depicts things that would probably cause quite a stir today, and you can feel the creators’ intensity and passion not only through the characters and story, but through the production itself. That energy is a big part of what makes the series so enjoyable. I do sometimes wish it would slow down and give each development a little more time to build.
review.jp: 時代を感じるが、決して古臭くて見れないことはない。今ではかなり問題視されそうなものもガンガン描くし、キャラや内容だけでなく作り手の熱さや情熱が伝わってくるし、それが本作を楽しめる大きな理由だろう。もうちょっと各展開をゆっくり積み上げても良いのでは？とは思う。

entries.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
entries.jpTitle: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～
entries.romanized_title: Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den
entries.synopsis: As maidens from the Five Clans battle for the Crown Prince’s heart, jealous Keigetsu uses forbidden magic to swap bodies with the beloved Reirin. Switching places does not guarantee happiness for Keigetsu with her new body's ill health leaving her hanging on the verge of death. Meanwhile, Reirin, now wearing the face of a scorned outcast, must answer for Keigetsu’s crimes in a dangerous trial.  The unlikely pair become increasingly entangled in each other’s lives and they will need to work together to survive after discovering the dark conspiracies brewing beneath the palace's genial surface. To confront the deadly threats lurking in the shadows, Reirin must embrace her new identity and defy their expectations of the court's inept villainess.  (Source: Crunchyroll)

review.en: Despite the ridiculous deus-ex-machina-like turn near the end of the first episode, which seriously lowered my expectations, it keeps getting more interesting with each episode. There are still parts of the story whose direction and depth are difficult to predict, while the relationships and the larger world around them are portrayed with surprising breadth and care. That works very well in its favor. I just hope it does not end up disappointing me.
review.jp: 当初の予想に反して回を増すごとに面白くなってきている。先の展開や深さが図りきれない部分があり、人間関係の描き方や規模も広く丁寧に描かれていて、そこがいい働きをしている。期待外れにならないといいなとは思う。

entries.title: Kaiju Girl Caramelise
entries.jpTitle: 乙女怪獣キャラメリゼ
entries.synopsis: Kuroe Akaishi just wants a normal high school life—but that’s impossible with a rare condition that turns her into a giant kaiju whenever her emotions spike! Things get even worse when she falls for Arata Minami, the most popular boy in class. Now every blush, heartbeat, and crush could trigger a monster transformation. Can Kuroe survive high school love before it destroys everything around her?!  (Source: Crunchyroll)

review.en: The heroine is absolutely adorable, and you can clearly feel the creators’ passion and affection for tokusatsu. It is unquestionably entertaining, but the story does not seem to be moving forward very much, and the repeated pattern is starting to feel a little frustrating. Her mother and her mother’s old male friend—who both seem to know something about the secret behind her transformations—have also been left hanging for quite a while, which bothers me. Minami-kun still does not really work for me, but strangely enough, I really like the equally over-the-top kaiju-obsessed girl. She adds a lot to the show.
review.jp: ヒロインは圧倒的に可愛く、特撮的なものの情熱・愛情もヒシヒシつたわるし間違いなく面白いのだけど、なかなか展開が進まないというか、ワンパターンの繰り返しというか、ちょっともどかしい。母親や友人の存在がずっと宙ぶらりんなのが気になる。怪獣マニアの子が個人的には好き。

entries.title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
entries.jpTitle: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
entries.romanized_title: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
entries.synopsis: On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Sorano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see.  Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side  (Source: Yen Press)

review.en: I honestly do not know what to make of this series. I was enjoying the way it portrayed relationships and romance involving someone with a disability from an angle we do not often see, but one issue has bothered me throughout: everything feels like a conveniently arranged plot device, with exactly what the story needs appearing exactly when it needs it. It also seems to withhold things that should naturally be shown, or prevent characters from behaving naturally, simply to make the drama work. That frustration keeps growing. Even so, I am very curious to see where it ultimately lands, what kind of ending it chooses, and how it gets there.
review.jp: 何なんでしょう、この作品。障害を持つ人との関わりや恋愛が今までにあまりない角度で描かれ、楽しんでもいたが、常に感じていた「全てがご都合な舞台装置であり、必要なものを必要なときに必要なだけ描く」、また「ドラマチックにするために、必要なことを謎に描かない、登場人物に自然な行動を取らせない」といったことが、どうしても残念感を爆上げする。その上で、一体どう帰着させるのか、どういう結末にするのか、どう描くのかが気になる。
